meta.title: De-Extinct: Jurassic Dinosaurs — Site Codex
meta.description: De-Extinct: Jurassic Dinosaurs — a base-building 4X strategy game on a lost research island. A catalogue of the island's systems, species and facilities.

hero.lede: A base-building 4X strategy game on a lost research island. This is the catalogue: what you build, what you hatch, and what gets loose.
hero.note: Opens the App Store in a new tab

plate.s01: The plate the store opens with — a breach, mid-charge.

idx.lede: Every plate from the store listing, filed and tagged. Filter by the phase of the game each one belongs to.

e1.note: Where squads prove themselves. Field combat comes first, then the arena, then the rankings.

e2.note: Where the roster starts. Hatch a species, then raise it to the weight it needs to be useful.

e3.note: Specialists, riders and their upgrades. Recruits who came for the science and stayed for the front line.

e4.note: The buildings that keep everything else supplied. Unglamorous, and load-bearing.

e5.note: Shelters, laboratories and defences, seen from above. Base upgrades are what unlock the rest.

e6.note: Fossils, the exhibition hall, and the revenue that pays for the rebuild.

named.lede: Named in the App Store description or visible in its screenshots. The full roster runs past 100.

dossier.lede: Taken from the App Store entry so that nothing here surprises you after the download.

d1.v: Free to download, with optional in-app purchases.

d2.v: Rated 12+ on the US listing; it notes violence, weapons and mature themes.

d3.v: Roughly 1.3 GB, and it needs iOS 13 or later.

d4.v: Strategy and simulation first, with social and alliance play built in.

q1.a: Yes. The App Store lists it as free to download with optional in-app purchases. There is no paywall in front of the install itself.

q2.q: Is it just a dinosaur game?
q2.a: No. The dinosaurs are the setting; the loop is 4X strategy — base building, research, squad growth and alliance competition. Expect timers and upgrades.

q3.a: Short check-ins work fine — collect, queue an upgrade, send a squad out. Longer sessions go into events, excavation and alliance work.

q4.q: Do I have to play with other people?
q4.a: You can get a long way solo, but alliances carry a large part of the late game and most of the seasonal events.

q5.q: Which devices does it run on?
q5.a: The listing asks for iOS 13.0 or later. Check the App Store page for the current requirement before you install.

final.p: Check the official listing for the current price, rating and device requirements before you download.
